$comment: The Agent Card is an A2A 1.0.0 AgentCard (JSON names as in the A2A specification, https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/). `input.agent_card` is the Card as fetched; `input.selected_interface_url` is the AgentInterface the client intends to call; `input.manifest` is the Manifest fetched from the Card's `params.manifestUrl` (inner body; placeholders resolve as for man-*), or `input.manifest_fetch` records a fetch outcome. The runner MUST NOT fetch anything. `card_signature_valid: true` stipulates that the A2A card-signature check passes; the `signatures[0]` value is illustrative (protected header {"alg":"ES256","kid":"card-signing-key-1","typ":"JOSE"}) and is not verified by the runner. No Manifest is supplied, so this fixture has no schema artifact.
description: The Agent Card carries an A2A card signature (A2A section 8.4) that the client is stipulated to accept, but the Manifest at `params.manifestUrl` cannot be retrieved (network error). RFC-AITP-0014 §4.4: a Card signature MUST NOT stand in for the Manifest binding. The fetch failure maps to MANIFEST_NOT_FOUND (RFC-AITP-0003 §4.1).

extensions.description: AITP peer trust. Verify the Manifest at manifestUrl; send the TCT in x-aitp-tct.

expected.rationale: Step 3 of RFC-AITP-0014 §4.2 cannot complete: the Manifest could not be retrieved, which RFC-AITP-0003 §4.1 maps to MANIFEST_NOT_FOUND (retryable). The accepted Card signature does not substitute for the Manifest (§4.4): A2A does not say whose key signs a Card.
